_what: OUTCOME-BLIND noise-floor thresholds tau_Upsilon/tau_IL/theta_G for the BASE-01 E-tier + A-tier gate, derived on the TUNING split (chronological first ~70%) of BASE-series.json. REVISED (Plan 04): tau_Upsilon is now a WITHIN-DAY two-referent measurement floor (BLOCKER-1 fix), tau_IL carries a price-snapshot-timing term (M3), the held-out split is re-cut for E1 referent positivity (B2). Held-out tail UNTOUCHED until the Plan-05 confirmatory run.
revision: Plan 04 re-open: B1 within-day tau_Upsilon (was cross-DAY revenue dispersion, a type error); B2 split re-cut (liquid E1 runnable, adverse E1 inconclusive); M1 A2b blocked + mu gate A3-only; M2 theta_G = measurement-sanity floor, A1 = beats-constant-G-OOS; M3 tau_IL += price-slip + decimals-asymmetry; M4 zero-fee-excluded sensitivity reported.
derivation_signature: derive_thresholds(tuning_split, decimals0, decimals1) - NO faithfulness-residual arg

within_day_upsilon.note: WITHIN-DAY two same-day referents (swap-side φ_obs·dW vs decimals-normalized accounting-side Δfg0·L/2^128), max relative disagreement over tuning days, per pool, max across pools (conservative). Fixes the BLOCKER-1 type error (prior τ_Υ was cross-DAY revenue dispersion). Lands ~1.7 — the honest floor of daily-aggregate free-tier data; E1 down-scoped to an order-of-magnitude collapse detector, A3 the primary μ discriminator (A2b blocked).

within_day_upsilon_zero_fee_excluded.note: WITHIN-DAY two same-day referents (swap-side φ_obs·dW vs decimals-normalized accounting-side Δfg0·L/2^128), max relative disagreement over tuning days, per pool, max across pools (conservative). Fixes the BLOCKER-1 type error (prior τ_Υ was cross-DAY revenue dispersion). Lands ~1.7 — the honest floor of daily-aggregate free-tier data; E1 down-scoped to an order-of-magnitude collapse detector, A3 the primary μ discriminator (A2b blocked).

decimals_quant.note: PER-POOL 1 raw unit / median interval fee, then max across pools (conservative). The 6-dec token1 floor dominates the liquid pool; the 18-dec token0 floor the adverse.

block_timing.note: analytic ±1-block slip over the ~1-day fee-growth window (1/window_blocks)

il_price_timing.note: M3: ±1-tick sqrtPriceX96 slip (1.0001−1≈1e-4, dominates) + decimals-asymmetry valuation (1 raw 6-dec token1 / typical reserve1), max across pools. E2 is an instantaneous reserve revaluation, so it needs a PRICE-timing term the fee-window floor lacked — prevents the false E2 HALT.

compose.tau_upsilon: RSS(within_day_upsilon, decimals_quant, block_timing)  # within-day two-referent disagreement dominates
compose.tau_il: RSS(il_price_timing.price_slip, il_price_timing.decimals_asym, block_timing)  # ±1-tick price slip dominates (M3)
compose.theta_G: RSS(decimals_quant, block_timing)  # MEASUREMENT-SANITY FLOOR (M2), not a fit bar; A1 gate = beats constant-G OOS
compose.direction: conservative — a LARGER τ is the anti-fishing-safe direction; never shrunk

gate_scope_decisions.E1: ORDER-OF-MAGNITUDE / <L_K,mu>-collapse detector (tau_Upsilon ~1.7 is the honest within-day floor of daily-aggregate free-tier data). A3 (the <L_K,mu> ~ Swap.liquidity pairing) is the PRIMARY mu-defect discriminator. E1 runnable on the LIQUID pool (4 held-out blocks with positive Upsilon-referent across distinct sigma-regimes); ADVERSE E1 pre-declared 'inconclusive: insufficient held-out referent' (only 1 of 4 held-out blocks has a positive token1 Upsilon-referent).
gate_scope_decisions.A2b: BLOCKED (per-tick fee-growth / outerFeeGrowth NOT in the free-tier snapshot - only GLOBAL day-delta totalFeeGrowth). The per-tick-shape mu test is DEFERRED. The mu gate is demoted to A3-ONLY (the <L_K,mu> ~ in-range Swap.liquidity pairing).
gate_scope_decisions.A1: theta_G=2.44e-5 is a MEASUREMENT-SANITY FLOOR (a fit worse than it = broken pipeline, not a model verdict). The LOAD-BEARING A1 gate is 'beats a constant-G OOS baseline'.
gate_scope_decisions.E2: tau_IL=1.03e-4 carries the M3 price-snapshot-timing term (+-1-tick sqrtPriceX96 slip ~1e-4, dominant) + decimals-asymmetry valuation; sign/directional agreement also required.

rule: NUM-03 4.3: noise_floor > tau => inconclusive/fail; tau NEVER raised.
honest_notes: tau_Upsilon is a WITHIN-DAY two same-day-referent disagreement (swap-side phi_obs*dW vs decimals-normalized accounting-side d(fg0)*L/2^128), max over tuning days, per pool, max across pools = liquid 1.72692.

It lands LARGE (~1.7): the swap-side dW is a daily-AGGREGATE volume proxy while the accounting-side is the exact fee-growth delta; their ~order-of-magnitude disagreement is the honest measurement reality of free-tier daily data. E1 is therefore an order-of-magnitude collapse detector, NOT a graded faithfulness gate; A3 is the primary mu discriminator.
M4 sensitivity: excluding zero-fee tuning days changes nothing (no tuning day has day_fee==0 in either pool); within-day max = 1.72692 unchanged.

tau_IL = RSS(price_slip=0.0001, decimals_asym=1.28638e-12, timing=2.44e-5) = 0.000102931; the +-1-tick price slip dominates (M3). The prior 2.44e-5 was the fee-WINDOW timing only and would false-HALT the instantaneous E2 reserve revaluation.
theta_G = RSS(decimals_fee, timing) = 2.44e-5 RELABELLED a measurement-sanity floor (M2); the A1 model gate is 'beats a constant-G OOS baseline'.

B2 split: LIQUID held-out [77690811,79418609,85631713,87884141] all have positive token1 Upsilon-referent (E1 runnable across distinct sigma-regimes); ADVERSE held-out has only 1 positive of 4 (79373468) => adverse E1 pre-declared inconclusive.
A2b BLOCKED: the snapshot carries only GLOBAL day-delta fee-growth, no per-tick/outerFeeGrowth - the per-tick mu-share test cannot run; mu gate demoted to A3-only.
A_Theta is THEORY-derived (SHREVE:838-859 logistic positivity/monotonicity), not data-derived.
